text: Hardened jHDF HDF5 store: write now canonicalizes declared payloads, computes SHA-256 checksum over checksum-null manifest plus dtype-normalized payload bytes, stores checksum in manifest and root attrs, verifies root/manifest checksum on read, and annotates payload datasets with lna_path/lna_role/lna_dtype/lna_unsigned attrs. Added tests for checksum rejection and logical unsigned attrs. Verified: sbt archiveJVM/test archiveJS/test datasetJVM/test datasetJS/test compileAll.
